engine-oil-dipstick.summary: A seated engine-oil indicator carries a blade into the sump so oil level can be compared with its original markings. This E9TE-6750-DA specimen study includes the yellow loop, stop and metal blade.
engine-oil-dipstick.limits: Only the approximate blade length has a specimen measurement. Oil calibration, guide tube, exact owner fit and installed route are unresolved; trial placement intersects the block.

steps.title: Establish the reference
steps.text: The stop seats against the guide tube and establishes the blade reference. This interface has not been measured.

steps.title: Read the original markings
steps.text: The wetted blade end is compared with the matched original indicator markings. Calibration marks are omitted because the photographs do not resolve them.

troubleshooting.title: Inconsistent reading
troubleshooting.text: Check seating, blade bends, readable markings and matched indicator/tube identity. Do not infer oil calibration from this candidate model.
